document.title: chore(js): upgrade pnpm and dependencies
document.summary: The JS toolchain moves to pnpm 12.15.0 and Node 24, the catalog takes the latest oxlint, oxfmt and tsgolint plus in-range bumps with React and Babel on their current majors, and the code the new lint rules flag is fixed.
document.why: Machines with pnpm 12 fail `pnpm --dir js build` with `ERR_PNPM_BAD_PM_VERSION` because `packageManager` pins pnpm 10.28.2 [per the request](source:t1).

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 26
sources.gist: Máté asks to move packageManager to the latest pnpm, adapt config to pnpm 11/12 defaults, keep Docker/CI pins in sync, bump deps within their major, and list skipped majors in the PR.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 26, follow-up
sources.gist: Máté asks for Node 24 (latest LTS), latest oxlint and oxfmt, Node 24 types, Babel 8 if it can be made to work, and React kept on 18 because React 19 needs a reconciler rewrite.

groups.title: pnpm 12 and Node 24
groups.why: pnpm 12 is the version on the dev machines [per the request](source:t1), and the follow-up asks for Node 24 [per the follow-up](source:t2).
groups.summary: `packageManager` and the Dockerfile pin pnpm 12.15.0, `.nvmrc` says 24 and CI reads it through `node-version-file`, and `allowBuilds: { esbuild: false }` keeps pnpm 12's strict build check from failing the install.
lookFor: Subtle: `esbuild: false` keeps pnpm 10's behaviour, where esbuild's postinstall was already skipped; without the entry pnpm 12 stops `pnpm install` with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`.
Subtle: `engines.node` is `>=24.16.0` because Node 24.16 is the first Node 24 whose bundled corepack (0.35) can launch pnpm 11+; older corepack crashes looking for `bin/pnpm.cjs`.
The SDK README and the deck-app-init skill still say Node 22+ on purpose: only this repo's toolchain moves to Node 24, not the SDK's author contract.

groups.title: Catalog bumps and the new lint findings
groups.why: The requests ask for in-range bumps [per the request](source:t1) and the latest oxlint, oxfmt and Node types [per the follow-up](source:t2); oxlint 1.89 with tsgolint 7 reports three new errors.
groups.summary: The catalog bumps oxlint, oxlint-tsgolint, oxfmt, `@types/node`, `@types/react`, rolldown and tsx, and the three files oxlint now flags drop a redundant cast or move a `setState` out of an effect.
lookFor: In the timers example, the Start and Cancel handlers now set the status text; Cancel only shows "Cancelled" while a timeout is pending, as the effect did before.
`rolldown` goes from `1.0.0-rc.18` to `1.2.15`; it is a runtime dependency of `@vitadeck/sdk`, so authors' `vitadeck build` bundles with it too.

groups.title: Demo app effects and the failure golden
groups.why: After merging `main`, oxlint 1.89's `exhaustive-effect-dependencies` rule flags two demo effects that used state only to re-run.
groups.summary: `TimersSection`'s hide timer reads the `toast` it hides, `FetchSection`'s retry calls `requestRepo()` from the press handler, and the failure-screen golden picks up the stack locations those bundles now produce.
lookFor: Subtle: a double press on "Fetch again" runs one request, because the handler returns while `request.status` is `loading`; before, each press bumped `attempt` and the effect cleanup dropped the older response.
A retry that resolves after the section unmounts calls `setRequest` on an unmounted component, which React 18 ignores; only the initial load keeps the `ignore` guard.

`13-failure-screen.png` changes only in the stack trace text: `runtime.js:1:16040` becomes `runtime.js:24:9124` because rolldown 1.2 keeps license comments, and the demo's `app.js` line moves with the `FetchSection` edit.

commits.subject: fix(demo): satisfy oxlint 1.89 effect-dependency rule; refresh failure golden
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
TimersSection's hide timer now reads the toast it hides, and FetchSection's
"Fetch again" fetches from the press handler instead of re-triggering the
effect through an unused dependency. The failure-screen golden shows stack
locations, which move with the rolldown bump and the demo edit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: chore(js): stay on Babel 7
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Babel 8 needs @rollup/plugin-babel replaced (its latest peers @babel/core ^7)
and changes class-field output for authors; not worth it for this upgrade.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: chore(js): Node 24, Babel 8, latest oxlint/oxfmt
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- Node 24.16+ everywhere: .nvmrc (CI reads it), engines, Dockerfile, docs
- @types/node 24, oxlint 1.89, oxlint-tsgolint 7, oxfmt 0.74; fix the new lint findings
- Babel 8 with options pinned to Babel 7 output; a small rolldown plugin in
  sdk/cli/babel.ts replaces @rollup/plugin-babel, whose @babel/core ^7 peer
  made every author install warn

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: chore(js): upgrade pnpm to 12.15.0 and dependencies within major
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- packageManager pnpm@12.15.0; lockfile regenerated (pnpm 11+ layout)
- allowBuilds: esbuild false keeps pnpm 10's skipped build under strictDepBuilds
- Dockerfile corepack pin follows packageManager
- catalog: @types/node 25.9.9, @types/react 18.3.31, oxlint 1.72.0, rolldown 1.2.15, tsx 4.23.15
- AGENTS.md: corepack < 0.35 cannot launch pnpm 11+

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
